title: 機械力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Dynamics of Machines I
keywords: Motion of rigid body 2.Impact 3.Work and energy 4.Friction 5.Vibration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the kinematics of rigid bodies when forces and moments of force act on them. (2) learn the concepts of momentum, work, and energy. (3) learn about machines in which friction is utilized. (4) learn the basis of vibration.
advice: This is a basic course on the dynamics of machines. We will cover the following topics: 1. Kinematics of rigid bodies 2. Dynamics of impact 3. Work and energy 4. Dynamics of friction 5. Dynamics of simple machines and mechanics 6. Vibration Students will also learn about advanced issues not found in the textbooks such as three-dimensional motion if time permits. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Each student is expected to solve the exercises by him- or herself. Students should pay attention to the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedule of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should not be absent from class, as they may miss handouts.
books: Textbooks: (in Japanese) Reference books: Engineering Mechanics: Dynamics [Wiley] Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Industrial Mechanics I and II. Enough skill in mathematics (especially differential/integral and vector inner/outcome calculations). Basic knowledge of mechanics (kinematics and moment of force). How to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the meaning of terms and to use SI units correctly.
Be able to explain the kinetics of rigid bodies.
Be able to explain changes in the motion of rigid bodies when they impact each other.
Be able to describe the energy of rigid bodies in motion.
Be able to analyze the motion of simple machines
Be able to describe vibration in mathematical terms.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Explain the concepts of terms such as momentum, energy, conserved force, and center of percussion, and correctly use SI units related to mechanics. (2) Express the three-dimensional motion of rigid bodies by equations and explain their behavior. (3) Analyze oblique impact and non-central impact. (4) Calculate the energy of rigid bodies in three-dimensional motion. (5) Describe the equations of simple machines and explain their motion by solving them. (6) Describe the equation of vibration in one degree of freedom and solve it.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Explain the meaning of terms such as momentum, linear impulse, energy, conserved force, and coefficient of restitution, and correctly use SI units for velocity, acceleration, angular velocity, momentum, angular momentum, work, energy, and power. (2) Express the planar motion of rigid bodies with equations. (3) Analyze the direct central impact of rigid bodies. (4) Calculate the energy of rigid bodies in planar motion. (5) Describe the equations of simple machines. (6) Describe the equation of free vibration in one degree of freedom.
